en.headline: Moonlit Bunny lights stay at Cultural Centre until Sunday
en.dek: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department says the STICKYLINE installation at the Cultural Centre Piazza is lit from 6:30pm to 11pm and runs until Sunday.
body: A Mid-Autumn lighting installation at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza is in its final weekend. The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said Moonlit Bunny Crew, by the local team STICKYLINE, runs until Sunday.

The department said the work uses geometric shapes to pick out landmarks of the district, with rabbit figures carrying cameras through the design. The lights are switched on daily from 6:30pm to 11pm. Extended lighting until midnight applied only on Mid-Autumn Day, which has already passed.

The installation was put up with the Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival programme and opened on 17 September. Admission is free. The Piazza is at the Cultural Centre in Tsim Sha Tsui, a short walk from the Tsim Sha Tsui MTR station and the Star Ferry pier.

zh.headline: 文化中心「月下兔仔團」燈飾展至周日
zh.dek: 康文署表示，本地團隊STICKYLINE的燈飾裝置置於文化中心廣場，每日傍晚6時半至晚上11時亮燈，展期至周日。
body: 尖沙咀香港文化中心廣場的中秋燈飾裝置進入最後一個周末。康樂及文化事務署表示，「月下兔仔團」由本地創作團隊STICKYLINE製作，展期至周日。
署方指，作品以幾何造型呈現區內地標，設計中的兔子拿着相機。燈飾每日傍晚6時半至晚上11時亮着。延長至午夜的安排只適用於中秋當日，該日已經過去。
裝置配合中秋綵燈會節目，於9月17日開始展出，免費參觀。廣場位於尖沙咀文化中心，由尖沙咀站及天星碼頭步行可達。
